steps.acceptance: - **Prediction:** on 083417 the piecewise model resolves the no_feedback joint probe, which the single gap cannot. The piecewise deviance of the nominal family falls below the single-gap deviance by more than the model's added degrees of freedom (a likelihood-ratio test at p < 0.01). - **Falsifiers, as in the issue:** - piecewise and single-gap exposures give equal joint-fit deviances on a run whose window holds a work-only pulse; - the piecewise model also leaves the no_feedback probe unresolved. That would place the inconsistency outside window exposure, for example in readout or reset, and the finding would say so. - **Commands:** `--self-check`, core-444, core-445, core-192, core-443, and the lint gates.
